scientific_integrity: A self-contained analytic argument proves an all-couplings lower bound and an attaining independent-base-sign random-cut scheme. Finite exact and numerical checks supplement but do not replace that proof. Fractional cut-cover theory and special Hadamard coefficients are prior work. Independent mathematical and priority review are outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Only a two-query equal-weight estimator with fully uniform Rademacher marginals, known graph support, and normalized unordered off-diagonal energy is covered. No claim of fast exact cut optimization, matrix-specific optimal coupling, adaptive estimation, or tail-risk dominance.
title: Fractional cut covers are the exact minimax law for two correlated sign trace probes
